Chapter 6837: Phenomena

Chapter 6837: Phenomena

“Fine, a more respectable death.” Li Qiye smiled and raised his hand, summoning golden strands from deep within the land.

He threw them forward, piercing the overlords and prompting them to scream in agony.

These massive beings only became larger once pierced by the golden laws, looking like continents. The golden laws connected them with the earth veins below.

More laws came and stitched them, connecting their flesh to the veins. Just like that, they looked like five golden continents from a distance.

Their vitality, dao power, chaos true energy, and everything else melted and seeped into the earth veins.

Their massive powers could nourish the earth veins and turn this place into a paradise. Meanwhile, everyone watched in amazement.

The ancient ancestors could tell that these overlords were still alive. This process was virtually eternal and excruciating.

“Only life can save this world, the sweet lives of overlords and immortals.” Li Qiye said with a smile.

Goldsilver and the others shuddered. However, he agreed that this must be done, as he remembered the past paradise.

Devouring Alliance ruined this world so the only way to save it was to undo what they had done. Of course, giving back required even more energy than the amount taken. The best way was to find all the overlords and immortals, channeling their essences back to the land.

“This is the way to save Stygian?” Goldsilver murmured while looking at the golden mountains.

Not everyone was heartless. Some immortals have tried to change Stygian before. For example, Immortal Emperor Min Ren and his allies killed Mang. However, they couldn’t change Stygian.

The cultivators of Golden Lamp never gave up either. However, the dream was so distant until today. This ordinary stranger somehow made Goldsilver think he could save it.

“Boom!” Suddenly, a spatial crack appeared deeper inside Golden Lamp. It opened wide like a bloody jaw.

“What is that?!” Everyone became afraid.

Immortal flames gushed out and engulfed the sky, forming the image of a glossy immortal ring. It was being flung around as if someone was exercising with a hula hoop.

Eventually, everyone also saw the silhouette of a gigantic bear inside the ring. The ring attempted to drag it back into the spatial gap.

“Bear Immortal!” Spectators shouted upon seeing their protector. However, something seemed amiss.

The bear roared furiously, channeling more power to stop the pull. Alas, he grew smaller as the ring overpowered him. Once he was dragged back inside the gap, all the phenomena dissipated.

“What is going on?” Thunder Emperor asked.

“Is he in trouble?” Six-foot asked.

“That wasn’t real, just a visual phenomenon permeating through space.” Goldsilver said.

“But it didn’t come from nothing.” She worried.
